text:
lena_csm: Quick heads-up — execs want a tight QBR peek next Wed (30m). Scope: account health + top 3 renewal risks + 2 demo flows. I pushed a bare deck here: https://redwoodinternal.slides/s/qbr-peek :eyes:

harry_success_mgr: 👍 when's the dry run?

lena_csm: Dry run Tue EOD. Need owners for: health summary, risk slides, demo 1 (onboarding), demo 2 (cost wins).

maya_enablement: I can own demo 1 (onboarding). Will pull 3 case highlights.

sam_dataops: I'll take health summary — pulling NPS, activation, top-5 regression signals. ETA Mon noon.

olivia_exec: For exec peek, keep 3 slides max. Call out 2 asks (ops & funding). Also include one-line mitigation per risk.

lena_csm: Noted — two asks: 1) extend onboarding enablement trial for HorizonPay; 2) allocate 250 dedicated inference hours for demo stability.

harry_success_mgr: I'll draft the risk slide bullets. Quick Q: do we classify HorizonPay as high or medium renewal risk?

sam_dataops: Based on health metrics and usage drop, i'd mark as high. I'll attach a short data snippet in the deck.

maya_enablement: For the onboarding demo, can we show the new onboarding checklist + automated playbooks? That reduced time-to-first-value in pilot.

olivia_exec: Yes, show delta numbers (before/after). Keep visuals minimal.

lena_csm: Action list (short):
- health summary: sam_dataops — Mon 12:00
- risk bullets + mitigation: harry_success_mgr — Mon 15:00
- demo1 slides + sample flow: maya_enablement — Tue 10:00
- demo2 (cost wins): lena_csm + eng liasons — Tue 12:00
- deck polish & speaker notes: lena_csm — Tue 17:00

harry_success_mgr: Added the risk bullets to the doc. PTAL: https://redwoodinternal.slides/s/qbr-peek#risk (small table with root causes). :mag:

sam_dataops: Dropping a short table from prod metrics: activation 7d -> 28% -> 42% after playbook. Will compress for slide.

maya_enablement: Quick ask — can eng provide a short log snippet showing staging latency improvement after batching change? Need for demo2. @sam_dataops can you pull?

sam_dataops: @maya_enablement I'll query logs, should have a snippet by EOD Mon.

calendar-bot: Reminder: QBR Peek scheduled Wed 11:00-11:30 in Exec Conf. Dry run Tue 17:30-18:00 in Ops Room.

olivia_exec: If HorizonPay is high risk we should add one mitigation with a short timeline. Harry, include a 30/60/90 plan line.

harry_success_mgr: On it — will add a 30/60/90 mitigation lane and owners.

lena_csm: Two tiny asks from me before dry run: 1) edit speaker notes to include a single ask slide with bullets; 2) embed one customer quote for onboarding.

maya_enablement: I have a short quote from HorizonPay PM — will paste into slide.

sam_dataops: Uploading the CSV + small chart to the deck now.

harry_success_mgr: Drafted speaker notes for the risk slide and added owner tags.

lena_csm: Great. If no objections, we meet dry run Tue 17:30. Please flag blockers now.

maya_enablement: No blockers from enablement side.

sam_dataops: Might need access to one billing report — pinging finance channel now.

harry_success_mgr: Will coordinate with sales for HorizonPay exec intro if needed.

olivia_exec: Thanks team. Keep slides concise. I'll join the dry run and give rapid feedback. :white_check_mark:

lena_csm: Thanks all — final checklist in the doc. See you at dry run.
